notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla's modkeys.rs is a macOS-only workaround for winit/Bevy stuck-modifier state after system shortcuts (ShiftCmd5 overlay) swallow flagsChanged release events - it polls NSEvent.modifierFlags and releases stuck keys. MSUI is a Windows client on Silk.NET/ImGui with a different input stack; the specific platform bug this module exists for cannot occur there, and no MSUI-relevant observable behavior corresponds to it.
